I’ve had many different vets over the years, but Dr. Singh at Abel Animal Hospital is by far the most thorough, compassionate, and caring…for both pets and their owners. His attention to detail and commitment to finding the root of a problem, rather than just treating symptoms, is something rare in a doctor these days.

I originally went to him for a BOAS surgery consult for my microbully, Lucy. I expected him to focus only on that, but he did a full, incredibly thorough exam and identified multiple issues I wasn’t fully aware of. And we left with a complete plan for her care. Dr. Singh performed Lucy’s BOAS surgery using a laser instead of a scalpel, which made healing so much faster. The results were amazing…he opened her nares and removed a significant amount of excess soft palate tissue from the back of her throat. He also runs full lab work, testing, and an EKG before surgery to ensure pets are safe for anesthesia. Lucy also has chronic nail splits and a persistent bacterial infection, and Dr. Singh has been working with me to get both under control. He also recommended a diet change after noticing food sensitivities, and now (except for her paws) her skin looks fantastic. He’s taken what felt like a daunting, hopeless situation and broken it into small, manageable steps that actually work.

The staff is equally wonderful…friendly, caring, and attentive. Once, when I forgot my phone charger, a staff member brought me her personal charger to use. Another time, when Lucy’s temperature spiked from stress, they rushed in with fans, ice packs, and cold towels, staying with us until she was calm. I have so many stories like this, and I’ve only been going there a few months.

I truly cannot give this office enough stars. I’m so grateful to have found Dr. Singh and his team, and I will never take my animals anywhere else. Very highly recommend!

**the first three photos are before Lucy’s surgery, and the last three photos were taken three days after surgery.

I had a veterinarian, Dr. Gongjoo Paik, that was seeing my dog at the Banfield Clinic in the South Loop.  She was very thorough and kind.  I often had to take my dog overseas (a service dog) and she was able to complete the USDA paperwork, which I then took for stamping at the USDA office near O'Hare.  Banfield charged $110 for this service.

Dr. Paik moved to Abell right at the time when the USDA updated their system, which allows the vet to quickly input the dog into the USDA computer and generate an approval in a matter of minutes.  I contacted Abell to get this paperwork done by Dr. Paik for a July trip.  Abell responded back with their service - $98 for the vet visit, $21 for a "Telehealth" visit, and $950.00 FOR THE ACTUAL USDA CERTIFICATE!

$950!  $950!  The USDA system takes 15 minutes by the vet sitting at a computer.

$950!

Not only highway robbery, but probably a violation of the ADA law.

Recommend the laser surgery for boas and I  recommend Dr. Singh and his team at Abell for anyone who is thinking about this procedure for their baby.
